attribution: Lichtman Laboratory (Harvard University) and Connectomics at Google; Shapson-Coe et al., Science 384, eadk4858 (2024), doi:10.1126/science.adk4858
scaleValidation: Compared first source node and radius to original proofread_104 Neuroglancer skeleton 1072605926: zero position error at 32,32,33 nm; matching radius.
displaySimplification: Nonbranching chains simplified with 0.7 micrometre positional tolerance; all junctions/leaf endpoints of largest .0 component retained. Omitted other disconnected SWC components. Cylinders approximate measured skeleton radii, not original segmented membrane meshes.
selection: Two smallest qualifying connected components per layer: >4500 nodes, >10 axon labels, >=12 clustered soma nodes, >=4 micrometres cluster extent on each axis. This is a reference subset, not a population estimate.

templates.layerBasis: Densest 15-micrometre class-3 soma cluster median sampled in official H01 layers at 4 x 4 x 4.224 micrometres; no M1/S1 labels inferred.
templates.somaShapeNote: Display ellipsoid from robust 90% source soma-cluster extent plus median soma skeleton radius; not segmented EM soma membrane.
